svg.title: tunisia-kit
svg.desc: NPM · TYPESCRIPT · ZERO DEPENDENCIES. The TypeScript toolkit for Tunisian data: validate CIN, RIB and phone numbers, format dinars, and look up banks, regions and other local reference data. 2,013 npm downloads in the last 12 months.
